json-schema-test-suite.description: Pairs built from the test cases of the official JSON Schema Test Suite for draft 2020-12: each schema against its instances, its negation and itself.

synthesized.description: Pairs that the containment test suite of Attouche et al. built from the official test suite for drafts 4, 6 and 2019-09, converted to draft 2020-12. Largely a near-duplicate of json-schema-test-suite.

rb-testset.description: The tests of the jsonsubschema tool, written for draft 4, some with the documents they reference embedded.

mergeallof.description: Schemas against the output of a rewriter that merges their allOf.

schemastore-versions.description: Successive versions of real schemas from SchemaStore.

oneof-as-anyof.description: Real schemas against themselves with oneOf replaced by anyOf: is oneOf used where anyOf would be equivalent?

uneval-as-additional.description: Schemas using unevaluatedProperties or unevaluatedItems against a translation to additionalProperties and items.

additional-as-uneval.description: Real schemas against themselves with additionalProperties and items rewritten through unevaluatedProperties and unevaluatedItems.
